The '''PW-3 ST Sniper Rifle''' was a model of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]] available during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The PW-3 ST Sniper Rifle was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the Outer Rim Explorer's Pack, which was released on [[July 22]], [[2015]].
